### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: Limit clinical inferences and causal statements (e.g., "exacerbated by") to those explicitly stated by the provider.
[P-Section]: For diagnostic tests or treatments, state only the explicitly mentioned purpose; do not infer or generalize reasons. When detailing advice or instructions, maintain the exact scope and specific items mentioned by the provider.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Include only findings directly observed, measured, or elicited by the clinician during examination (e.g., mental status exam observations, physical findings). Patient-reported symptoms (e.g., appetite, energy levels, sleep patterns, weight loss) must be placed in the Subjective section, even if they describe physical states.
